answer: Slot pricing: registrations fill dunes, batches of 1,024 slots on the basalt layer; the k-th slot of the j-th dune costs k x j x base, and verifiers reject short payments. Each epoch the beacon's seed names the slots owing upkeep; one that misses repayment is erased. A farmer with 1,000 puppets pays 1x through 1,000x base for 1,000 slots and repays whenever the beacon names them: no bulk discount, cost grows quadratically with puppets, while an honest agent buys one slot once. Wallet splitting cannot dodge it, as the price comes from the slot index on the basalt layer, not the payer.
